verdict.rationale: The integrations docs say one command points a tool at a model and starts it with nothing to configure by hand. The Wally docs name `opencode` as a launched tool whose `--cloud` flag switches from the local model to hosted, implying local by default, and the same CLI runs local models offline. Community failure reports concern the separate rcli voice tool, not this launcher, so they do not create a dispute. Missing for 10: evidence covering more than one third-party agent (only opencode is named, so 'popular' agents in the plural is unshown), a documented list of supported agents, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
